title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP07a-prep — depth-independent package root for the Architecture Conformance binding tests
goal: Make the base-owned GatePolicyBindingTests resolve the package root from LAYERGUARD_PACKAGE_ROOT or the nearest directory holding policy/layerguard.json, so that CP07a can build the single template source tree under candidate verification (D26).
acceptanceCriteria: Both GatePolicyBindingTests.cs copies stay byte-identical and resolve the package root from LAYERGUARD_PACKAGE_ROOT or by searching upward from the fixtures, failing when no policy is found.
Invoke-IFX.ps1 passes LAYERGUARD_PACKAGE_ROOT for Test and restores it, isolated trusted base processes do not inherit it, and the template identity check runs in Check and Generate only.

The binding tests pass from the template fixture location without the variable, the package tests pass, and the pull request consumes the CP07a-prep-auth authorization with all 13 required checks passing.
